config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.expup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "explicit-secret"

[providers.catup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "catalog-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-exp"
provider = "expup"
model = "explicit-up"

[catalog]
url = "{UPSTREAM}/catalog"
timeout = 5
refresh_seconds = 0
headers = { "X-Catalog-Token" = "cat-secret" }

[catalog.model_providers]
"cat-1" = "catup"
"cat-2" = "catup"

[llama_cpp]
timeout = 2
refresh_seconds = 0
prefix = ""
aliases = true
compatibility = "strict"
servers = [{url="{UPSTREAM}", name="localup", api_key="fake"}]
name: m4_llama_models_order
